items.title: Rebecca Kilgore interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997
items.q: We met about a year ago. We were both teaching at a music camp on Vashon Island in Washington State.

ctx.x: Yes, I think it has. It’s helped me in my homework for sure, because I think if you can play a chordal instrument like a guitar or a piano it can help you to learn the material and understand it. I’m always leery of singers who learn songs from other singers’ recordings, just by ear. I mean I’m sure that’s a valid way to do it, but I always like to know what the correct melody was as written. And I try to get the sheet music and know, from the source, what it was like. And so I think the guitar for me is a great…
How long have you and Peter been together?

About a year. We met about a year ago. We were both teaching at a music camp on Vashon Island in Washington State. He was teaching bluegrass banjo and I was teaching guitar and vocals I guess. He’s trying to teach me bluegrass.
